pages.text: SERVICES AGREEMENT. This Agreement is entered into by Northwind Supply Co. ("Vendor") and Example Client LLC ("Customer"), effective as of the date of last signature below.

2. Services. Vendor shall provide monthly infrastructure monitoring services as described in Exhibit A. Vendor shall deliver a status report to Customer on the first business day of each month, summarizing uptime, incidents, and remediation steps taken during the prior period.

2. Services (continued). Customer shall designate one technical point of contact to receive Vendor's monthly status reports and to coordinate any required system access. Vendor shall maintain no less than 99.5% monitoring uptime measured on a calendar month basis.

5. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party. Upon termination, Vendor shall promptly return all Customer data and confidential materials in its possession.
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT. This Agreement is entered into by Solara Consulting Group ("Vendor") and Riverstone Holdings Inc. ("Customer").
3. Fees and Payment. Customer shall pay Vendor's invoiced fees within thirty (30) days of receipt. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

7. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to the other party. No refund of prepaid fees is owed upon termination for convenience.
Telemetry Subsystem Interface Control Document. This document has no detected section headings and is chunked using the page-aware fallback path rather than section-derived chunking.

The subsystem shall transmit sensor readings every five hundred milliseconds over a redundant CAN bus with automatic failover. The subsystem shall buffer up to sixty seconds of readings locally whenever the primary telemetry uplink is unavailable, and shall flush the buffer in chronological order once the uplink is restored, without duplicating or dropping any buffered reading.

Firmware updates shall be delivered over-the-air with cryptographic signature verification, and any update that fails signature verification shall be discarded without being applied to the running system.

Employee Handbook Excerpt. Announcements: please give notice to building security at least one day before bringing a guest on site. Notice boards in the break room are updated weekly with cafeteria menus.
Remote Work Policy. Employees who work remotely must provide two weeks notice to their manager before relocating to a new city, so that payroll and tax withholding can be updated in advance.
